_comment: Copy this to mcp_servers.json (gitignored) and set your own paths. Local LLM Studio connects to these MCP servers. Safety policy: by default ONLY tools whose names start with a READ prefix (get/list/search/check/read/describe/find/query/summarize) are exposed to the model. A server may set an explicit 'allowed_tools' whitelist to override that. Auth lives inside each server (never handled here).

servers.name: Example Node server with an allow-list
